comparisons.reason: Item 0 is a narrow subtype. It requires a comment to explicitly quote or near-verbatim reproduce a specific factual claim from the OP and then refute it. Quoting without refuting, refuting without a quote, and opinion or value claims all give 0. Item 1 is broader. Any comment with a concrete objection, evidence, example or reasoning aimed at a particular OP claim gives 1, with no quote requirement and no factual-claim restriction. Many rows would be 1 for item 1 and 0 for item 0, so the extraction functions differ.
